scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const root=process.cwd(); const dist=path.join(root,'dist'); const outputPublic=path.join(root,'frontend','.output','public'); fs.rmSync(dist,{recursive:true,force:true}); if (fs.existsSync(outputPublic)) { fs.cpSync(outputPublic, dist, { recursive: true, force: true }); } else { fs.mkdirSync(dist,{recursive:true}); }"
scripts.build:dev: npm --prefix frontend run build:dev && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const root=process.cwd(); const dist=path.join(root,'dist'); const outputPublic=path.join(root,'frontend','.output','public'); fs.rmSync(dist,{recursive:true,force:true}); if (fs.existsSync(outputPublic)) { fs.cpSync(outputPublic, dist, { recursive: true, force: true }); } else { fs.mkdirSync(dist,{recursive:true}); }"
